title: cynanchica lactea

It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and potential health benefits of Cynanchica lactea, but it has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments.
